Audio Agent

Audio Agent is a voice assistant for Android. You press a button, speak, and the assistant answers aloud. It can also run actions: play music, set timers and reminders, keep notes and lists, check the weather, read your calendar and help you call a contact.

This is an alpha version

Audio Agent is in alpha, earlier than beta. It is experimental software made by one person. Expect bugs, missing features and changes without notice. Do not rely on it for anything important or safety-critical, and do not use it as your only way to call for help or to keep reminders.

There is no guarantee of support or updates.

What it is

It has no server of its own and no account. It talks directly to AI services (Qwen and DeepSeek) with API keys that you enter yourself, so you need your own keys and an agreement with those providers.

Who it is for

The app is built around people who find a touch screen hard to use:

  • blind and low-vision users, who can control it without looking at the screen
  • people with limited use of their hands, who can use a remote control, a keyboard or one large on-screen button
  • anyone who wants hands-free voice control

How you control it

  • A Bluetooth remote control (fob) or the keys of a keyboard, also with the screen off
  • A large button on the screen and the Android accessibility button
  • Your voice: hold or tap to record, then release to send

The app uses the Android accessibility service only to receive the presses of the remote control and keyboard that you set up. It does not read the screen or other apps.

Download

Requires Android 12 or newer. The app is not in Google Play. You install an APK file that you download from GitHub Releases.

By downloading you accept the Terms.

How to install

  1. Download the APK file on your phone.
  2. Open it. Android asks to allow installing apps from this source (your browser or file manager). Allow it for this install.
  3. Android Play Protect may warn that the app is unknown. This is expected for an app outside Google Play.
  4. Open Audio Agent and follow the first screens: they explain the permissions. Then enter your own API keys in Settings.
  5. Optional: compare the SHA-256 value in the table with the file you downloaded.

Privacy

There is no developer server, no account, no analytics and no advertising. Your voice and requests go from your phone straight to the AI providers whose keys you entered. This site makes no requests to third parties.
